# lwIP source

`lwip/` is a source snapshot of https://github.com/heiher/lwip
at `495671e59d736ef59f6cfa7dc9d35b7359921062` (LICENSE and src/).
The original license and copyright notices are retained.

Local changes:

- Transparent UDP lookup includes the input netif, honoring the listener's
  interface binding when different interfaces receive the same source endpoint.
- Embedding-specific isolation: IPv4/IPv6 reassembly keys include the input
  netif, and interface teardown silently frees that interface's pending
  fragments. This gives separate TUN instances independent fragment identities.
  Ordinary lwIP netifs share one IP stack; per-interface reassembly isolation
  changes that behavior and should be discussed separately before upstreaming.
- TCP GSO has a separate aggregate-size limit (`gso_max_size`), preserving the
  negotiated `mss` for congestion control. IPv4/IPv6 output leaves tagged GSO
  packets to the device instead of IP-fragmenting them.

The embedding configuration is in ../../lwipopts.h. C translation-unit
wrappers are generated by `go run ./cmd/build-lwip generate` and compiled by cgo.

## Planned fork and upstream contribution

The planned fork is based on `heiher/lwip`. Keep the transparent UDP netif
binding fix in a separate commit, with a minimal C regression test suitable for
an upstream PR. `tests/udp_netif.c` is independent of the Go/native bridge;
`go run ./cmd/build-lwip test-upstream-udp` demonstrates IPv4/IPv6 failure before and success
after just that predicate. Proposed title: `UDP: Respect netif binding when matching pretend PCBs`.
Maintain per-netif fragment reassembly isolation separately as
an embedding requirement; discuss its semantics and optional configuration with
upstream before proposing it for general use.

Keep the TCP/IP GSO changes in a third, independently reviewable commit. The
embedding's opt-in capability policy, ABI metadata, IPv6 MTU initialization,
Win64 fragment-header configuration, native buffering and Windows diagnostics
belong to sing-lwip rather than the UDP upstream change.

The native-GSO validation archive contains three independently applicable
patches under `upstream-patches/`. The UDP-only patch was tested against the
pristine pinned upstream sources, without the embedding configuration or
either other patch: IPv4/IPv6 each misroute four datagrams before it and none
after it. Applying all three patches reproduces the vendored `src/` byte for
byte. The standalone fork commits and upstream PR are not yet published.
